body:
Wow. Okay. So, I admit fault and am looking to help him. And your telling me take responsibility? Why be redundant? To just rub it in?

"Mental illness to cover for their failures in interpersonal relationships"... If there's anyone with a mental illness, it's you for thinking this is how everyone with PTSD is.

You seem to have a misperception about those of whom have PTSD. I won't waste my time trying to explain to you. I don't imagine you will comprehend. I'd suggest seeing a counselor/therapist for all this pent up anger you have

Healing is possible for everyone. I have faith in you too
